caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware jar with two small loop handles on its sides, placed symmetrically on the upper portion of the vessel. The jar is an earthy beige or tan color with a smooth surface. There is a decorative floral pattern in blue on the front of the jar, featuring two stylized, symmetrical flowers with large petals and leaf-like forms extending outward, as well as additional leaves or stems filling the space below. Near the top and between the handles, a stamped or inscribed text reads "FAVORITE SALT KING & SWAT." The rim of the jar is wider and slightly flared, with the interior rendered in a dark shade, possibly black or deep blue. The background of the drawing is plain and light, making the jar stand out as the central subject. The artist’s name, “GEO. T. OYSCHIRIDGE,” is inscribed near the bottom right of the image.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
